abstract: Cystic teratomas of the mediastinum are rare and present with severe respiratory distress during childhood. Aspiration of the cyst is indicated to reduce the cyst volume, alleviate the patient's symptoms, and secure an operative field. This report describes a 4-month-old male baby with a large anterior mediastinal teratoma presenting with severe respiratory distress. The cystic teratoma was large enough to cause pectus carinatum. Respiratory distress secondary to airway obstruction was markedly reduced by percutaneous aspiration of the cyst. Surgical excision is indicated for a malignant or benign well-demarcated mass in any part of the mediastinum. In our patient, total surgical excision was performed. Preoperatively, percutaneous aspiration was performed twice, with the symptoms being reduced after each aspiration. Surgical excision is the best means of diagnosing and treating a benign teratoma. Percutaneous cyst aspiration not only improved ventilation but also facilitated easy excision of the cyst during surgical management.
abstract_ja: 縦隔の嚢胞性奇形腫は稀であり、小児期に重度の呼吸窮迫を呈する。嚢胞の穿刺吸引は、嚢胞容積を減らし、症状を軽減し、手術野を確保するために適応となる。本報告は、重度の呼吸窮迫を呈した前縦隔の大きな奇形腫を有する生後4か月の男児の症例を記述する。嚢胞性奇形腫は鳩胸(胸骨隆起)を生じるほど大きかった。気道閉塞に続発する呼吸窮迫は、嚢胞の経皮的穿刺吸引により著明に軽減した。術前に経皮的穿刺吸引を2回行い、そのたびに症状が軽減した。本症例では全切除術を施行した。良性奇形腫の診断と治療には、外科的切除が最良の手段である。経皮的嚢胞穿刺は換気を改善するだけでなく、外科的管理において嚢胞の容易な切除も可能にした。
